propositions: Code review lacks a concurrency correctness rubric; existing overlays cover only attacker-framed TOCTOU and load-shaped patterns, leaving races undetected

A lockset-first (Eraser/RacerD inconsistent-synchronization) rubric fires via two-layer deterministic lexical triggers: committed high-precision token list (sync primitives) plus project-extensible noisy tier in criteria_routing.json

The committed tier deliberately excludes modal unlocked-twin races (raw git rm+commit, getmtime-then-remove on lockfiles) to stay portable; project-specific vocabulary in criteria_routing.json catches repo-specific races without code changes

Four production races in this repo (eclectic-spotted-barb, fine-wisteria-solenodon, greisen-draconian-annelid, fervid-boring-python) demonstrate the gap; the two-layer split lets built-in overlay remain portable while this repo catches its modal unlocked-twin class

The overlay ships advisory (block_threshold 0.95, blocking_enabled false) with documented blind spots (no-twin races, CI-level CAS judgment) and explicit recall boundaries between committed and project tiers
